---

**Summary of extraction:**

I fetched and analyzed the complete Scallop Lending specification across 12 pages:
- Main lending page, sCoin page, borrowing page, interest rate page, liquidations page, obligation page, risks page, oracles page, fee page, outflow limit page, core architecture page, and all three contract integration function pages (lending, borrowing, liquidation).

From this specification, I identified and extracted **12 program graphs** covering every functional unit in the Scallop Lending protocol:

| ID | Function | Description |
|:---|:---------|:------------|
| SG-001 | `mint` | Supply assets to lending pool, receive sCoins (MarketCoin) |
| SG-002 | `redeem` | Withdraw assets by burning sCoins at current exchange rate |
| SG-003 | `open_obligation` | Create Obligation + ObligationKey using HotPotato pattern |
| SG-004 | `deposit_collateral` | Deposit collateral into an obligation (permissionless) |
| SG-005 | `withdraw_collateral` | Withdraw collateral (requires ObligationKey + health check) |
| SG-006 | `borrow` | Borrow against collateral (health check, fee, outflow limit, isolated asset constraint) |
| SG-007 | `repay` | Repay borrowed assets (permissionless, excess refunded) |
| SG-008 | `liquidate` | Soft liquidation of unhealthy positions (partial, not full) |
| SG-009 | `flash_loan` | Zero-collateral loan within single transaction (0.1% fee) |
| SG-010 | `interest_accrual` | Trilinear interest rate model with 3-phase utilization curve |
| SG-011 | `risk_level_calculation` | Health factor computation using collateral weight, borrow weight, liquidation factor |
| SG-012 | `outflow_limit` | 24-hour rolling window rate limiter for borrows/withdrawals |

Each `.mmd` file encodes the full program graph (nodes, edges, actions) with `note right of` blocks containing formal invariants. All files are located under `/Users/hiro/Documents/security-agent/outputs/graphs/batch_w0b4_1773060675/scallop-lending/`.

**Summary of extraction from Scallop Lend: Borrowing specification**

I extracted **10 program graphs** from the borrowing specification at `https://docs.scallop.io/scallop-lend/borrowing`, supplemented with the interest rate model page. The functional units cover the full borrowing lifecycle:

| ID | Name | Description | Key Invariants |
|:---|:-----|:------------|:---------------|
| SG-001 | `create_obligation` | Creates Obligation object + mints ObligationKey NFT | Max 5 sub-accounts per address; 1:1 key-obligation binding |
| SG-002 | `deposit_collateral` | Deposits collateral into Obligation (requires key auth) | Collateral stored in Obligation, not pool; no supply interest |
| SG-003 | `calculate_collateral_value` | Computes weighted collateral value across all deposited types | `collateral_weight` in (0,1]; value = SUM(amount * price * weight) |
| SG-004 | `calculate_debt_value` | Computes weighted debt value using borrow weights | `borrow_weight` >= 1; volatile assets penalized |
| SG-005 | `borrow` | Core borrow flow with health check, rate limit, and liquidity check | debt <= collateral post-borrow; 24h outflow limits; interest accrued first |
| SG-006 | `withdraw_collateral` | Withdraws collateral with health factor preservation | Must remain solvent; counts toward outflow limit |
| SG-007 | `transfer_obligation_key` | NFT-like ownership transfer of Obligation control | Full control transfer; collateral/debt stay with Obligation |
| SG-008 | `flash_loan` | Uncollateralized same-transaction loan | 0.1% fee; hot-potato receipt pattern; must repay in same tx |
| SG-009 | `repay` | Repays debt with excess refund | Capped at outstanding debt; interest accrued first |
| SG-010 | `accrue_interest` | Trilinear interest rate model compounding | 3-kink model; idempotent for same timestamp; compounds on existing debt |
